title: ligularia hodgsonii var. sutchuenensis
intro: Ligularia hodgsonii var. sutchuenensis, commonly known as 'Sutchuen Ligularia', is a plant species within the asteraceae family, characterized by its large, showy yellow flowers and serrated leaves. The plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ligularia hodgsonii var. sutchuenensis include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing, primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Bioactive constituents present in the plant, such as ligularin, have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, further supporting its therapeutic applications.
